The pay is Rs.1,28,359/- per month consolidated. The essential qualification is a postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB) as set for each department. how_to_apply: Applications are submitted only through a Google Form, on or before 16.11.2026, 04.30 PM. The notice lays down these steps.
Open the home page of www.jipmer.edu.in and go to the link "RECRUITMENT TO THE POST OF SENIOR RESIDENT ON CONTRACTUAL BASIS AT PUDUCHERRY/KARAIKAL/YANAM – NOVEMBER 2026".
Start the registration through the Google Form and fill in the candidate details carefully; no change is accepted after submission.

Upload a recent colour passport size photograph with a light background, taken while holding a placard showing the candidate's name and the date of the photograph (30 mm × 45 mm, 20 KB to 80 KB, file named like "Meera Photograph.jpg"). A photograph with the name and date edited in afterwards will be rejected; black and white or Polaroid photographs are not accepted.
Upload the signature, made with a black ball point pen on plain white paper in an 80 mm × 35 mm area, scanned and cropped to that size (20 KB to 80 KB, file named like "Meera Signature.jpg").
Upload each applicable certificate separately in JPEG/JPG/PDF format, up to 1 MB each.

Pay the fee through SBI Collect: on www.jipmer.edu.in click Online Payment, tick "I have read and accepted the terms and conditions stated above", click PROCEED, select RESIDENT RECRUITMENT FEE, fill in Notification No. SR-CONT/1/2-2026/ADMN.VI, date 02.11.2026, post SENIOR RESIDENT and the other details, then select SUBMIT and pay.
Save the payment copy and upload it in the Google Form along with the other documents for reconciliation.

The fee is paid only online through SBI Collect; DD, cheque, MO, IPO, CRF, cash or any other mode will not be accepted. The bank may charge an additional service charge, and the fee once remitted will not be refunded under any circumstances.
MBBS degree certificate and internship completion certificate
National Medical Commission registration for MBBS, PG/DNB and DM/MCh/DrNB (if applicable)
Residence certificate from a Revenue authority not below Tahsildar/Dy. Tehsildar, or Aadhaar card/voter ID/Passport
SC/ST, OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates in the Annexure-I, II and III formats, if applicable
No Objection Certificate from the present employer as per Annexure-IV, for candidates in service in a government hospital or institution (if applicable)
Disability certificate as per Annexure-V (if applicable)
important_instructions: Candidates employed under the State or Central Govt., a PSU or an autonomous body must produce an NOC from the competent authority; without it they will not be allowed to appear for the interview. An application is rejected for not meeting the age limit or the eligibility for the discipline, for an OBC sub-caste not in the current Central OBC List or a certificate not in the Annexure-I format, for SC/ST or EWS claims without a valid certificate in the prescribed format, or for not completing the course and Junior Residency by 16.11.2026. A candidate who finds an entry error must submit a new application with the prescribed fee; the earlier application stands cancelled automatically. A rejected application can only be replaced by a fresh application with another payment. Applications without the prescribed fee, or incomplete in any respect, will be rejected; so will applications whose photo or signature is small or not visible in the preview. No individual intimation will be sent. The interview date, results, joining and any changes will be displayed only on www.jipmer.edu.in. Selected candidates get 15 days to join, with a further 14 days in exceptional situations; otherwise the offer is cancelled and goes to a waitlisted candidate, if any. Appointment is subject to being declared medically fit by the competent Medical Board. No travelling or other allowances are paid for attending the screening test/interview or joining. A person who has married someone with a living spouse, or who has married again while having a living spouse, is not eligible for appointment unless exempted by the Director. Candidates should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. Possessing a mobile phone or other electronic gadget in the interview hall, canvassing, impersonation or fabricated documents will lead to cancellation of candidature. Disputes are subject to courts at Puducherry.

For queries on applying for Senior Resident posts, contact the Assistant Administrative Officer on 0413 2296022 or at [email protected] (give your application number and mobile number), during office hours 09.00 AM to 01.00 PM and 02.00 PM to 04.30 PM.

content_sections.heading: About JIPMER
content_sections.text: JIPMER, at Dhanvantari Nagar, Puducherry, was declared an Institution of National Importance by an Act of Parliament in 2008 and runs a hospital with more than 2000 beds. Its second campus, JIPMER Karaikal, was established in 2016 and trains students at the 506-bedded Government General Hospital, Karaikal. JIPMER has also set up a Multi-specialty Consulting Unit at Yanam to provide health care in selected specialties.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: JIPMER has advertised 9 Senior Resident posts in six departments. The department-wise and category-wise break-up is as follows. All Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry shall be posted to work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Senior Residents recruited in the Department of Radiodiagnosis will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly and will make periodic visits to the Karaikal campus on rotation basis. Reservation for Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBDs) is 4%, provided on a horizontal basis. The minimum degree of disability is 40%, assessed by the JIPMER Medical Board, whose decision will be final. The acceptable disabilities for each department are given in JIPMER O.M No.Admin-I/DR/PwD/2021, dated 18-03-2023. Applicants of any category may be considered for a reserved seat only when no applicant of that reserved category is available; candidates of other categories, including Unreserved, will then be considered for appointment not exceeding beyond 40 days, which may be extended further by the competent authority if required. The vacancy position may be revised or changed as per requirement.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: JIPMER invites applications from eligible Indian candidates. The essential qualification for each department is as follows. The crucial date for eligibility with regard to age and educational qualification is 16.11.2026. Candidates must complete all requirements for the qualifying degree, such as passing the examination and completing the mandatory period of Junior Residency, if any, by 16.11.2026. Those who do not fulfil these conditions need not apply. Appearing in the written exam or interview does not imply that a candidate is finally eligible. The full name in the application must match both the Govt. Photo ID card (Aadhaar, PAN, identity card, driving licence etc.) and the undergraduate degree certificate, in the same spelling and order. The upper age limit is not exceeding 45 years as on the crucial date, 16.11.2026. Age relaxation beyond the upper age limit is permitted as follows. OBC: a valid OBC certificate for posts under the Central Government, stating that the candidate does not belong to the Creamy Layer, issued in the current financial year, in the Annexure-I format. It must not be older than one year before 16.11.2026. EWS: persons not covered by SC, ST or OBC reservation whose family has a gross annual income below ₹ 8 lakh from all sources for the financial year before the year of application. A valid EWS certificate in the Annexure-III format is required, failing which the candidature will be rejected. SC/ST: a valid certificate in the Annexure-II format. SC, ST, OBC (NCL) and EWS certificates should be issued by a Tahsildar or higher authority. A certificate in a regional language must be uploaded with an English version attested by a Gazetted Officer. Disability: a certificate from a duly constituted Medical Board of a State or Central Govt. hospital or institution, countersigned by the Medical Superintendent/CMO/Head of Hospital, in the Annexure-V format. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: A post graduate medical degree viz MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatric. DM/DrNB (Neurology) from recognized university/Institute or equivalent qualification may also apply.
A post graduate medical degree viz, MS/DNB in Surgery. MCh./DrNB (Neurosurgery) from a recognized university/Institute or equivalent qualification may also apply.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: if more applications are received, the competent authority may shortlist candidates for the in-person interview on criteria it fixes, to limit the number of candidates called. Certificate verification: held at the Administrative Block, JIPMER Puducherry, on 18.11.2026. The Important Dates give the venue as 5th Floor, Telemedicine Room, IT Wing, Administrative Block, JIPMER Campus, with reporting at 07.00 AM. Only candidates whose certificates are found in order may appear for the interview. Interview: candidates must report at 07.00 AM sharp at the JIPMER Administrative Block; no candidate will be entertained after 8.30 AM. The turn for interview may be delayed depending on the number of applicants. Merit: the weightage of the personal interview is 100%, and separate merit lists for SC/ST/OBC/UR/EWS/PwBDs are prepared on the basis of the interview. In a tie, the elder candidate (earlier date of birth) ranks higher. A waiting list is operated only when necessary and gives no assurance of an offer. Marks are not displayed, and there is no re-checking or re-evaluation. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in JIPMER Recruitment 2026 for Senior Residents?
faq.answer: There are 9 Senior Resident posts: 2 in Neurology, 1 in Neurosurgery, 2 in Obstetrics & Gynaecology, 1 in Pathology, 2 in Radiodiagnosis and 1 in Transfusion Medicine (UR 6, OBC 2, SC 1).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to register for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Online registration through the Google Form closes on 16 November 2026 at 04.30 PM. It opened on 2 November 2026 at 11.00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: An NMC/MCI-recognized MD/MS/DNB in the respective discipline is required. Neurosurgery needs MS/DNB in Surgery, and Neurology needs MD/DNB in Medicine/Paediatric, with MCh/DrNB or DM/DrNB holders also allowed to apply. The degree and Junior Residency must be complete by 16.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for JIPMER Senior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age must not exceed 45 years as on 16.11.2026. Relaxation is 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10, 13 and 15 years for PwBD candidates of UR/EWS, OBC and SC/ST respectively.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a JIPMER Senior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs.1,28,359/- per month consolidated, with no enhancement during the contract period.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for the JIPMER Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.500 for General (UR), OBC (NCL) and EWS candidates and Rs.250 for SC/ST candidates; Persons with Disabilities are exempted. It is paid only online through SBI Collect and is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for JIPMER Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Register through the Google Form linked on the www.jipmer.edu.in home page, upload the photograph, signature and certificates, pay the fee through SBI Collect, and upload the payment copy in the Google Form by 16.11.2026, 04.30 PM.

faq.question: Q8. How are JIPMER Senior Residents selected?
faq.answer: After certificate verification on 18.11.2026, candidates whose certificates are in order appear for an in-person interview. The interview carries 100% weightage, and candidates may be shortlisted if many applications are received.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the JIPMER Senior Residents be posted?
faq.answer: Senior Residents recruited at JIPMER, Puducherry will work at the JIPMER Karaikal Campus on rotation basis. Radiodiagnosis Senior Residents will be deputed to the Yanam Campus regularly, with periodic visits to Karaikal.

faq.question: Q10. Is the JIPMER Senior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract appointment advertised for 11 months. The terms state 12 months at a time, continued up to 3 years on the HOD's recommendation and the Competent Authority's discretion.
